note: NECO Government round 5 (R30 top-up): granted, enacted and evolved constitutions; constitutionalism; parliamentary privileges, the Speaker, quorum, state opening; devolution vs federalism, confederation's retained sovereignty, local tier; civil service commission, privatisation vs commercialisation, tenement rates, Chapter II fundamental objectives; courts settling federal disputes, exclusive items, equal state voices in the upper house; political culture, impartial electoral body, delegated legislation's merits, coalition and multi-party systems, 1999 party opening; defence and treaty functions, emergency proclamation, immunity clause, executive council; unicameral argument, permanent secretary, checks against tyranny, defection law, 1960 constitutional monarchy. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Government (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
